_comment: Knowledge-graph content the bootstrap loads into the runtime dataset (S0.5 Pass B3 item 2; Ella, S525, decision 2): B28's three model-content graphs, named by graphs.ts (KG_GRAPHS), never here. 'graph' is the key of a knowledge-graph graph: domain holds the 12-file General-only stack of S0.1 pass 2 plus the Cafe's tenant types (with their axis declarations and runtime axis vocabulary, S0.5 Pass B8) and the Cafe's reasoning module; correspondence holds the correspondence records; metamodel is named and stays empty at Stage 0. The Ears and CQC instance files are not loaded. Paths are relative to /stack/kg-source inside the container, where compose.yaml mounts the repository's ontology/ (as ontology/) and generated/ontology/ (as generated-ontology/), read-only: build outputs, never the authoring rig. The first file of each graph replaces the graph (Graph Store Protocol PUT); the others are added to it (POST).
